a39b75c013f25931d216d70e7c49d107cae90b46.summary: Project page for Sliver, an open-source, cross-platform adversary emulation and red team framework intended for authorised security testing. It describes command-and-control over mTLS, WireGuard, HTTP(S) and DNS, support for macOS, Windows and Linux, and GPLv3 licensing with install instructions. It describes a tool, not a threat actor, campaign, malware incident or vulnerability, so it is not a threat report.

a35cc21a595cd3651df0e7ad8e3f2eb726939764.summary: A GitHub repository by Tillmann Werner with information on the Conficker computer worm. It contains YARA rules to detect unpacked variants of the worm in memory, Snort rules to detect exploitation attempts in a network, unpacked samples of each Conficker generation, and code to remediate infections. The samples contain malicious code. The last commit is dated Nov 20, 2018, and the data is copyright 2008-2018.
